name: Kzan Thornslash
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Kzan Thornslash supplies weapons to new Horde recruits. He is an orc merchant in Durotar.

sections.title: Armorer to the Recruits
sections.body: Kzan Thornslash supplies weapons to young orcs and Darkspear trolls in the Valley of Trials. They are taking their first steps as Horde warriors. He offers basic hand axes, shortswords, clubs, and staves for recruits facing local wildlife and hazards.

faq.answer: Kzan Thornslash is an orc merchant in the Valley of Trials. He supplies new Horde trainees with standard weapons for their first combat trials.

faq.q: Where can I find Kzan Thornslash?
faq.answer: You can find Kzan Thornslash inside the Den, a cave in southwestern Durotar's Valley of Trials. Novice adventurers and their training instructors gather there.

faq.q: What kind of equipment does Kzan sell?
faq.answer: Kzan sells basic weapons for recruits, including axes, swords, daggers, staves, and bludgeons. They offer reliable iron until recruits acquire forged or found gear.

angles.text: As a young warrior starting with a chipped blade, you can find blunt and edged weapons from Kzan to suit different combat disciplines.
As a member of the Horde, you can see its nascent armies begin with merchants like Kzan, who supply steel for every capable hand.
